instruction: Please disable the background cone icon in VLC. I find it distracting when the player is idle, and I'd prefer a cleaner interface without the cone visible in the background.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
